paper.title: Towards high-fidelity wind farm layout optimization using polynomial chaos expansion and Kriging model

public_source.contents: manuscript TeX and source figures only; no executable code, data arrays, CFD case, mesh, response table or random state
public_source.author_code_search: no target author repository located in bounded paper, arXiv, GitHub and author-page search

case_iv.model_role: high-fidelity ADM-RANS in paper; declared ADM-Gaussian proxy in reproduction

paper_method.infill_lifecycle: maximum surrogate prediction until repeated optimum then expected improvement

missing_information: author FLORIS, DAKOTA and modified OpenFOAM source plus exact versions and options
machine-readable 72 by 22 wind distribution and exact NREL power curve revision
PCE LHS arrays, basis construction, selected orders and cross-validation partitions
Kriging kernel, correlation length search, nugget, regression rank handling and posterior variance configuration
GA operators, random seeds and complete layouts or convergence responses
ADM-RANS source, eight CFD cases, mesh, fields, boundary conditions and 626k-cell artifact
Case-IV high-fidelity responses and all per-run output arrays
mathematical_conflicts: Printed Equation 21 substitutes the prediction for the historical best used by Equation 20 and standard expected improvement; use best-observed EI.
A full quadratic trend has 153, 561 and 2145 terms for Cases I, II and III, exceeding their 80, 160 and 320 initial layouts; use identifiable additive quadratic trend with 33, 65 and 129 terms.
Fifty PCE samples cannot identify the 66-term total-degree-ten bivariate basis; cross-validation is restricted to total degree at most eight with 45 terms.
The paper omits the DAKOTA posterior-variance configuration; use a conservative nearest-observation squared-correlation variance proxy and do not claim DAKOTA variance replay.

Case IV reports 108.51 MW for eight 5-MW turbines, above the physical 40-MW instantaneous farm limit; treat it as an unnormalized direction aggregate or unit-label inconsistency and report physically averaged proxy power.
completion_decisions: Implement all four paper case sizes, target truth-call totals, native repeat counts and the PCE-Kriging-MSP-EI-GA lifecycle.
Reconstruct the 72-direction distribution from the licensed source figure and the 22-speed distribution as a declared truncated Weibull fit.
Use a pure equation-level Gaussian wake proxy for Cases I-III and a separately labelled asymmetric ADM-Gaussian proxy for Case IV.
Use empirical orthogonal polynomials, common-random-number 50-point LHS, five-fold cross-validation and degree at most eight.
Use additive quadratic trend, squared-exponential residual Kriging, deterministic initial-design concentrated-likelihood length selection, rank-one Cholesky append and standard best-observed EI.
Run every target role with all available Waffle CPU cores; use one-core execution only for the three-repeat H6 speed reference.

hpc_contract.persistent_team: one persistent all-core team per run
parallel_axes: independent PCE wake-state work inside each layout when exposed as a batch
independent Kriging predictions for every GA population
independent selection crossover mutation and repair for every non-elite offspring
surrogate_acceleration: rank-one Cholesky extension for every Kriging infill
fixed layout slots and deterministic ordered reductions
hpc_contract.determinism: same scientific hash, layouts, history and objective values for one and all CPU workers
hpc_contract.h6_workload: Case III batch of 320 layouts with 50 PCE wake states per layout

formal_protocol.h6_worker_pair: one CPU worker versus every available Waffle CPU core

claim_boundary: Flexible equation- and lifecycle-level academic reproduction of the target PCE-Kriging-MSP-EI-GA method and four paper problems on declared Gaussian and ADM-Gaussian proxies. It is not author FLORIS, DAKOTA, OpenFOAM, ADM-CFD, random stream, layout, response array, numerical table or timing replay.
